messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
Before the looms learned the secret of coal, the world moved on river-roads, wind-songs, and the patient turning of seasons, and no engine ever stole its breath from smoke, and the chronicles named this age Before
River cities rose in spirals of timber and glass, their towers leaning like listening reeds, while barges carried letters, seeds, and rumors through the green arteries of the continent, and the maps named this age River
Wheel and axle remained humble, serving carts, mills, and orreries, while scholars measured time by polished stones rather than gears, and music became the true engine of progress, and the academies named this age Wheel
Wind gardens bloomed along coastlines, their silk petals tuned to carry whispered messages, and navigators read the air like a book whose pages were made of cloud, and the seafarers named this age Wind
Air currents taught the first flying markets to drift above the forests, their canvas wings embroidered with maps of the wind, and children grew up believing the sky was a gentle river with many currents, and the skyward towns named this age Air
Stone archives grew under the mountains, each chamber inscribed with histories, treaties, and songs, while priest-engineers shaped water through carved channels that sang when the moon rose, and the deep keepers named this age Stone
Sea empires navigated by the moods of whales and the songs of currents, their ships carrying not only cargo but entire gardens, libraries, and moving temples to distant shores, and the tides named this age Sea
Mind over mechanism ruled the academies, where memory, intuition, and trained imagination could predict storms, heal wounds, and guide travelers through dreams, and the wise named this age Mind
Dream festivals ended the age of silence, as people from every village gathered to share visions of future worlds, and the oldest among them whispered that history would never need a factory, and the night named this age Dream
After the last bellows of the forgotten age, the world kept its slow green pulse, and no smoke ever rose to stain the moon, so the stars became the true archive of every road, river, and dream, and the world named this age After
